differences.before: Operations contract: The operations contract is renewed one quarter at a time. The ground team works short-handed.
differences.after: Operations contract: Quarter-by-quarter operations funding leaves the ground team with less support.

differences.before: First image downlink: The first downlink pass is missed and the image arrives a day late. Mallory announces it anyway.
differences.after: First image downlink: Limited partner tracking makes the first image downlink less certain. Mallory has already announced his broadcast slot.

differences.before: Thruster glitch during the orbit raise: The supplier's team sends a thruster software patch within hours. The orbit raise finishes on schedule.
differences.after: Thruster glitch during the orbit raise: The supplier's prompt thruster support improves the orbit-raise team's readiness.

differences.before: Arrival at the geostationary slot: The moved launch left less rehearsal time. An extra trim burn eats into the station-keeping fuel.
differences.after: Arrival at the geostationary slot: The moved launch left less rehearsal time and more uncertainty about the final trim burn.
